name: Fort Charles
text: Fort Charles is an abandoned British fort situated on the island of Nevis. It is now mostly in ruins.

depictions.name: Fort Charles
depictions.text: Fort Charles (Jamaica) Fort Charles is a fort in Port Royal, Jamaica. During the 18th century, it was a Royal Navy military base. Built circa 1660, it was the only fort in Port Royal to survive the earthquake of 1692, and would later play host to the trials of several infamous pirates, such as Anne Bonny, Charles Vane, Edward Kenway, Jack Rackham, and Mary Read.
